snippet.title: Super Mario Journey Lane 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Here is the official 2025 trailer for Super Mario Journey Lane! I've made so much more progress on the mod since the last trailer in 2022, and now I'm happy to finally make a new one and show you guys what I've been making since then!

It has been forever since the creation of Super Mario Journey Lane. I started this project all the way back in 2017. Almost 8 years since it first started! And throughout these years I've been learning so much just to make this project the best it can be. And now I can confidently say Super Mario Journey Lane will be released this year! I just need a little bit more time to finish up this last bit of progress. Please be patient for little bit longer 🙏.

Within the last year I brought on pants64 (https://www.youtube.com/@pants64) to help with custom code/ASM. Without him, the project wouldn't be what it is today. He is a huge part of Journey Lane now and I'm forever grateful for him.

As for the fans of Super Mario Journey Lane, I will forever be grateful for each and everyone one of you as well. It's because of your support throughout these years that I've had the motivation to keep going with it. 8 years is a very long time and I'm very happy to know Journey Lane has had so much support during that time. Thank you guys so much. Until then, I hope everyone of you enjoy this new trailer! This'll give you a glimpse of what you can expect from the final product. Hope you guys enjoy!! 😁
_________________________________________________________
